## Statistical Software

### `scalexptest`: Scale-Exponential Hypothesis Testing
**Language:** R  
A supplementary R package accompanying [*Unified Hypothesis Testing in the Scale-Exponential Family*](/publications/journal-articles/scalexptest.qmd) (*METRON*, 2026).
Computes critical regions and statistical power values across distributions derived from the general scale-exponential family framework.

## Linux

### Arch Linux Automated Installer (`arch-install`) (In Progress) with Installation Guide
**Language:** Shell  
**Links:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/arch-install) | [Installation Guide (Wiki)](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/arch-install/wiki)  
An automation script and configuration framework for bootstrapping UEFI-only Arch Linux installations featuring LUKS encryption, Btrfs subvolumes, a swap file, and GRUB.
Includes post-installation setup for a minimal KDE Plasma (to be replaced with Hyprland) environment and Snapper snapshots.

### Arch Linux + Hyprland Dotfiles
**Tech:** Shell, Lua  
**Links:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/dotfiles)  
My personal custom configuration files and scripts for a minimalist,
keyboard-driven Arch Linux +‌ Hyprland environment.

## Selected Undergraduate Projects

### Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) & Autodiff Engine from Scratch
**Language:** Python  
**Link:** [Notebook](/assets/notebooks/mlp.ipynb)  
A modular neural network framework built without external deep learning libraries.
Implements custom `Layer` and `Neuron` classes, an automatic differentiation engine for backpropagation, and gradient-based optimization.

### Perceptron Classifier from Scratch
**Language:** Python  
**Libraries:** scikit-learn, NumPy, Matplotlib  
**Link:** [Notebook](/assets/notebooks/perceptron.ipynb)  
A minimal implementation of the classical Rosenblatt perceptron learning algorithm built from scratch and applied to binary classification on a toy dataset.

### Hybrid MPSO-CNN
**Tech:** Python  
**Libraries:** TensorFlow, NumPy  
**Link:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/Hybrid-MPSO-CNN)  
Implementation of the paper Hybrid MPSO-CNN: Multi-level Particle Swarm optimized hyperparameters of Convolutional Neural Network by Pratibha Singh, Santanu Chaudhury, and Bijaya Ketan Panigrahi,
utilizing swarm intelligence to optimize CNN architectural hyperparameters.

### N-Queen Evolutionary Algorithm
**Language:** Python  
**Libraries:** NumPy, Pygame  
**Link:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/n-queen-evolutionary-algorithm)  
An evolutionary computation approach solving the classical $N$-Queen problem using metaheuristic optimization techniques.

### Sudoku Solver
**Language:** Python  
**Link:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/sudoku-solver)  
An algorithmic solver utilizing constraint satisfaction and backtracking logic to solve arbitrary Sudoku puzzles efficiently.

### Task Manager CLI
**Language:** C++  
**Link:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/task-manager)  
A program to divide and manage tasks of an organization between the employees.

### Conway's Game of Life
**Language:** Python  
**Link:** [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/phrafsanjani/game-of-life)  
An implementation of John Conway's cellular automaton cellular simulation.
